d:
Nae sal men prabhu ji mala mala bana do
Kashmiri seb jaise mere gal bana do
Aur jhagra mita do sara
Hind-pak ka prabhu
Islamabad bas meri sasural bana do... naya sal hamse bas kuchh ghante dur hain, to nav varsh ke aagman par dharmaraj upadhyay ki ye shandar kavita aap bhi sunie sirf sahity tak par.
